title: Fix token refresh race condition
description: Users report random 401 errors after token refresh in mobile app

context.symptoms: Mobile app shows 401 Unauthorized after successful token refresh
context.duration: Ongoing since PR merged 3 days ago

success_criteria: All users can refresh tokens without 401
Token refresh is idempotent (same result on retry)
Rate limiting is in place (prevent brute force)
Test coverage includes concurrent refresh scenario
notes: Likely race condition when multiple concurrent refresh attempts hit the endpoint simultaneously
